choice.text: Sure man! Here ya go bro!
I got nothing but let me go to a shop and grab ya something homie!

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Easy, kid. No harm done. I've heard worse from better.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Go on. Show me some skating.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Bless you, kid. That's a hot meal tonight.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Now go on. Show me something good.

effects.banner: Mission: buy Gus a hot dog!  The stand is back to the left - skate backwards!

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: That's real kind of you. The hot dog stand's just back down the block. Get the works.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: The hot dog stand's back down the block, kid. Mustard and onions, the works.

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Here you go, Gus. Fresh off the grill.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Mustard AND onions. Kid, you're a good one.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: I won't forget this. And here's a tip: rails love speed. Jump early, hold the button, and don't brake mid-grind.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Back again? Speed first, then jump. The rest is just style.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: And watch the pothole past the market. It's got a grudge against skaters.
